q1_issues.issue: The "whenever" rule's consequent is not tied to its trigger — the mandated (During <response> <trigger>) link is missing and no conjunct mentions $h, so the derived potency state has no anchor to the harvest occurrence and the prescribed "whole conclusion bundle" query shape cannot match.

The consequent's Skolem state term is indexed only by the salt-bloom, (sk_potent $s), rather than per occurrence / by every universal scoping over it, so two harvests of the same bloom collapse onto one state witness.
(Measure (sk_potent $s) duration 1 season) invents the magnitude 1 for the definite period "the season", which supplies no count word.

q2_gaps: duration expressed as a definite period NP ("for the season", "for the winter") — no count word, so the (Measure e duration <n> <unit>) form has no stated magnitude and the bare-plural at-least-two rule does not apply

a recurring astronomical / tidal occasion used as a temporal anchor ("at the new-moon spring tide") — neither a calendar term, deictic, day-part nor clock time, so whether it is a bare Time constant or a typed definite witness is unaddressed
a "whenever" response that is a persisting state with its own stated extent rather than a co-temporal occurrence — the mandated During tie to the trigger does not fit a result state that outlasts it
notes: The bare constant new_moon_spring_tide carries no type or decomposition atom, which the oblique-object NP rule ("an article mints a witness with its kind atom") would want but the "a deictic or named time stays a bare symbol" rule permits. Otherwise the trigger clause uses plain variables correctly, "a Keeper" takes the capitalized-common-noun default, the continuation copular gets its Still + flat pair, and no QuantifierPhrase companion is emitted, all as prescribed.
